headline: Flat and onshore today; Wednesday brings something to ride.
today: Barely a foot of SSE at short period with a light dawn that goes onshore by mid-morning. Glassy but tiny at first light on the incoming — log it if you're already local, otherwise nothing to chase. This is a wait day.

daysToWatch.note: E swell to 2ft-plus but only a fair angle here and short period, with dawn NE cross-off. Fun on a groveler early, though Rockaway is the better call for the same swell.
1.6-2.4ft on a prime angle but short-period and cross-on most of the day. Marginal — surfable early if the wind stays light.
